mapper.insert: INSERT INTO jwt_revocation ( jti_sha256, user_id, expires_at_epoch_ms, token_expires_at, revoked_at, revocation_reason, instance_id, trace_id, created_at ) VALUES ( #{jtiSha256}, #{userId}, #{expiresAtEpochMs}, #{tokenExpiresAt}, #{revokedAt}, #{revocationReason}, #{instanceId}, #{traceId}, #{createdAt} )
mapper.select: SELECT revocation_id FROM jwt_revocation WHERE jti_sha256 = #{jtiSha256} FOR UPDATE
SELECT checkpoint_key, checkpoint_status, min_valid_iat_epoch_ms, activated_at, updated_by, updated_at FROM jwt_revocation_checkpoint WHERE checkpoint_key = #{checkpointKey}
